en: A sepia-toned postcard depicting a large building partially obscured by trees, with a prominent tower featuring a clock and a pointed spire. The foreground shows a grassy area and some benches, with the building set back behind a hedge. The style of the architecture suggests a historical European structure, likely a manor or small castle. The text on the postcard includes the words 'Pulsnitz' and 'Schloss,' indicating the location and type of building.
